task: TCP forwarding proxy (TcpRelay) with half-close, idle timeout and connection limit
reasoning_summary: Wrote 12 tests first against in-process upstream servers, then a relay with two pump threads per connection. Half-close is propagated with shutdownOutput; idleness uses a shared lastActivity timestamp checked on SO_TIMEOUT polls so one-way streaming is not misread as idle. All tests passed first run and 6 repeat runs.
